ns2:section.sectionText: The College Experience, 2 hours. How and why does the University operate, and why should you care? This course takes a critical look at what higher education in America is all about, with special attention to the U of I. We'll watch films and we'll talk about these issues, in depth. This course can be taken for 2 or 3 credit hours. Students who enroll for the 3 credit hour option (45715) will investigate the course's topics in greater depth. First year Discovery Program course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. For more information, go to < https://netfiles.uiuc.edu/hschein/www/ >.
